name: Stampezee
summary: Digital stamp cards for local businesses, replacing paper punch cards. Public pricing stays thin, so re-check the tiers before committing.
best_for: local businesses (cafés, salons, retail) that want a simple digital stamp-card loyalty program and can judge it inside a 14-day trial
skip_if: you need POS-integrated loyalty with CRM depth (bigger platforms exist), or your offer isn't repeat-visit shaped
honest_knock: The category is honest and proven (digital stamp cards beat lost paper cards), and the platform is young with limited public review coverage — so use the 14-day trial on a paid plan to run one real campaign and measure repeat-visit lift before the first charge, because the refund policy excludes changes of mind and unused plan periods. The deeper truth of loyalty programs: the mechanics are 10% of the outcome; a reward worth returning for is the other 90%.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Stamp Lite · per month for 1 branch and 1 active stamp card, with a 14-day free trial
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-19 on stampezee.com/en/pricing, the plan cards plus the plan data behind them) The free tier is gone from the page. Three paid plans, each now with a 14-day free trial, plus a custom-priced Enterprise Plan. Stamp Lite $29.99/month: 1 branch, 1 active stamp card, unlimited customers and stamps, signup rewards, EzeeCodes and Give Stamps, birthday/anniversary/referral automations, no push notifications. Stamp Pro $49.99: 3 branches, 4 cards, spend-based stamping, tiered and exclusive rewards, lapsed-customer automation, 5 push notifications, a VIP card completion path. Stamp Elite $99.99: 10 branches, 12 cards, 10 push notifications including location-based ones, scratch-card campaigns, email marketing, a custom stamp card design, an exclusive marketing package and a dedicated account manager. Enterprise Plan: custom pricing based on locations, scale, usage and business requirements, with custom branch, card and usage limits and advanced roles and permission controls. The annual term (“Save 17%”) is in the plan data rather than on the cards: $299.99, $499.99 and $999.99 a year, ten months' money. StampEzee prices by region: the same data lists EUR 19.99, 39.99 and 69.99 and GBP 14.99, 29.99 and 59.99 a month. What changed since the 30 August 2026 reading: Stamp Start (free: 1 branch, 1 card, up to 100 customers or 100 stamps) no longer appears, Stamp Lite went from 2 branches and 3 cards to 1 and 1, Stamp Pro from 6 cards to 4, and the push allowances on Lite, Pro and Elite moved from 1, 4 and 8 to 0, 5 and 10. The monthly and annual prices did not change.
